core_obligations: Set up the generators (proof lines 11230-11236): both second cohomology groups are identified with Z/nZ by the companion result, and the coboundary of the class of a degree one line bundle is shown to be a generator.

Compute the pullback on generators (proof lines 11236-11242): the pullback of the class of a line bundle is the class of the pulled back line bundle, whose degree is the degree of the morphism, and naturality of the coboundary identifies the pullback on the second cohomology groups with multiplication by that degree.
proof_roadmap: Identify the two second cohomology groups with cyclic groups by the companion isomorphism.
Pick generators as coboundaries of the classes of degree one line bundles.
Use naturality of the Kummer coboundary and multiplicativity of the degree under pullback.
difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the pullback map on the second etale cohomology with roots of unity for a nonconstant morphism of smooth projective curves over an algebraically closed field as multiplication by the degree (statement lines 11219-11228). The proof is a complete computation: the companion result identifies the two groups with Z/nZ, the generator is realized as the coboundary of the class of a degree one line bundle under the Kummer sequence (proof lines 11230-11236), and naturality of that coboundary together with multiplicativity of the degree under pullback gives the asserted multiplication (proof lines 11236-11242). The non-formal content is the choice of generators and the naturality argument. The claim is H2: a short but complete computation with each input named.
